On November 13, 1972, the Village of Park Forest passed the resolution for the use of Motor Fuel Tax Funds for the purpose of moving the screen plantings. A formal agreement specifying the understanding between the Illinois Department of Transportation and the Village of Park Forest will be prepared and submitted to the Village of Park Forest upon receipt of the Federal approval of this proposed improvement. The screen planting was removed and replaced outside the proposed highway right-of-way in the Spring of 1973.
K. Roosevelt School in Chicago Heights
Frontage land from Roosevelt School in Chicago Heights will be required for right-of-way purposes to accomplish the highway widening and reconstruction. After replacing as much contiguous land as feasible to the school site, there will be a resulting irreversible commitment of 4,385 square feet (0.10 acres) of open space land to highway purposes.
An agreement has been reached between the City of Chicago Heights, School District 170, and the Illinois Department of Transportation to provide replacement land for the land taken from Roosevelt School and its playground. The Department of Transportation will construct a cul-de-sac on Sunnyside Avenue, thus, by closing this portion of Sunnyside Avenue the playground area to the west of the school will become immediately contiguous to the school building and the hazard inherent in school children crossing the street to use the facility will be eliminated. The Department of Transportation has also agreed to replace all sidewalks which will be affected by the highway improvement. The existing pedestrian underpass will be replaced with a pedestrian overpass which should be easier to maintain and police. The replacement of the shrubbery and fencing which will be disturbed due to the highway reconstruction may be included in the contract plans, or the cost of these items will be included in the right-of-way settlement. The selection of either of these two alternates is up to the school district. All parties involved in this plan are in agreement, however, the arrangement will not be formalized until negotiations for right-of-way commence.
